        (RADIUS_X_M - EDGE_ROUND_M, 0.0),

        (RADIUS_X_M, THICKNESS_M - EDGE_ROUND_M * 0.4),
        (RADIUS_X_M - EDGE_ROUND_M, THICKNESS_M),

        cent=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        angle=math.radians(360.0),
        steps=RADIAL_SEGMENTS,
        use_duplicate=False,

    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts[:], dist=1e-6)
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces[:])
